#include "x430.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "x430_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define X430_READ_PARAMS 4U
#define X430_WRITE_HEADER 2U
#define X430_OPTION_PARAMS 5U
#define X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY 5U
#define X430_FAST_SEGMENT_OVERHEAD 4U
#define X430_FAST_HEADER 8U
#define X430_STATUS_DATA_MAX (DXL2_MAX_PARAMETER_SIZE - 1U)
#define X430_TX_BODY 7U
#define X430_TX_ERROR 8U
#define X430_TX_DATA 9U
#define X430_TX_LENGTH 5U
#define X430_STUFFING 0xFDU

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE TYPE DEFINITIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

enum x430_target
{
    X430_TARGET_PRIMARY = 0, 
    X430_TARGET_SECONDARY,   
    X430_TARGET_BROADCAST    
};

/* Alignment probes (see x430_device.c) */
struct x430_align_bus_ctx
{
    char c;
    struct x430_bus_ctx x;
};

struct x430_align_bus
{
    char c;
    struct x430_bus x;
};

_Static_assert(sizeof(struct dxl2_link) == X430_DXL2_LINK_BYTES,
               "X430_DXL2_LINK_BYTES in x430_types.h does not match this DXL2-C version");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct x430_bus_ctx) <= sizeof(struct x430_bus),
               "X430_BUS_BYTES in x430_types.h is too small for this ABI");
_Static_assert((sizeof(struct x430_align_bus_ctx) - sizeof(struct x430_bus_ctx)) <=
                   (sizeof(struct x430_align_bus) - sizeof(struct x430_bus)),
               "struct x430_bus is not aligned for struct x430_bus_ctx");

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: HELPERS
 * =============================================================================*/

static uint32_t x430_millis(const struct x430_bus_ctx* m)
{
    const struct x430_port* port = m->config.port;
    uint32_t now = 0U;

    if ((port != NULL) && (port->millis != NULL))
    {
        now = port->millis(port->context);
    }
    return now;
}

static void x430_lock(const struct x430_bus_ctx* m)
{
    const struct x430_port* port = m->config.port;

    if ((port != NULL) && (port->lock != NULL))
    {
        port->lock(port->context);
    }
}

static void x430_unlock(const struct x430_bus_ctx* m)
{
    const struct x430_port* port = m->config.port;

    if ((port != NULL) && (port->unlock != NULL))
    {
        port->unlock(port->context);
    }
}

static bool x430_stuffed_at(const uint8_t* tx, uint32_t index)
{
    return (tx[index] == 0xFDU) && (tx[index - 1U] == 0xFFU) && (tx[index - 2U] == 0xFFU);
}

static void x430_write_tx(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, size_t length)
{
    if (m->config.write(m->config.write_context, m->tx, length) != 0)
    {
        m->write_failed = true;
    }
}

static void x430_delay_status(const struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct x430_device* device)
{
    const struct x430_port* port = m->config.port;
    const uint32_t delay =
        (uint32_t)x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_RETURN_DELAY_TIME) * X430_RETURN_DELAY_UNIT_US;

    if ((delay != 0U) && (port != NULL) && (port->delay_us != NULL))
    {
        port->delay_us(port->context, delay);
    }
}

#define X430_LEVEL_PING 0U
#define X430_LEVEL_READ 1U
#define X430_LEVEL_ALL 2U

static bool x430_answers(const struct x430_device* device, uint8_t needed)
{
    return x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_STATUS_RETURN_LEVEL) >= needed;
}

static void x430_send_status(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct x430_device* device, uint8_t id,
                             uint8_t error, uint16_t length)
{
    uint16_t count = 0U;
    size_t total = 0U;

    if (error == DXL2_ERR_NONE)
    {
        count = length;
    }
    m->tx[X430_TX_ERROR] = (uint8_t)(error | x430_device_alert(device));
    total = x430_frame_status(m->tx, sizeof(m->tx), id, count);
    x430_delay_status(m, device);
    x430_write_tx(m, total);
}

static bool x430_magic_ok(const uint8_t* parameters, uint8_t b1, uint8_t b2, uint8_t b3, uint8_t b4)
{
    return (parameters[1] == b1) && (parameters[2] == b2) && (parameters[3] == b3) &&
           (parameters[4] == b4);
}

static uint8_t x430_id_of(const struct x430_device* device)
{
    return x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_ID);
}

static struct x430_device* x430_find(const struct x430_bus_ctx* m, uint8_t id)
{
    struct x430_device* found = NULL;

    for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
    {
        if (x430_id_of(m->devices[index]) == id)
        {
            found = m->devices[index];
        }
    }
    return found;
}

static bool x430_group_read(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address,
                            uint16_t length)
{
    const bool answered = x430_answers(device, X430_LEVEL_READ);

    if (answered)
    {
        uint8_t error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

        (void)x430_device_read(device, address, length, &m->tx[X430_TX_DATA], &error);
        x430_send_status(m, device, x430_id_of(device), error, length);
    }
    return answered;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Turn-taking of SYNC_READ and BULK_READ on a shared bus. On one wire a device
 * answers only after the status packet of the ID listed before it in the request
 * (X series behaviour); devices of this bus answer one after the other, and a device
 * after an ID of another bus waits until that status packet has been received.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

static void x430_turn_cancel(struct x430_bus_ctx* m)
{
    m->turn_count = 0U;
    m->turn_next = 0U;
}

static void x430_turn_add(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, uint8_t id, uint16_t address, uint16_t length,
                          uint8_t* after)
{
    struct x430_device* device = x430_find(m, id);

    if ((device != NULL) && (m->turn_count < X430_MAX_DEVICES_U))
    {
        struct x430_turn* turn = &m->turns[m->turn_count];

        turn->device = device;
        turn->address = address;
        turn->length = length;
        turn->after = *after;
        m->turn_count++;
        *after = X430_TURN_NOW;
    }
    else
    {
        *after = id;
    }
}

static void x430_turn_run(struct x430_bus_ctx* m)
{
    bool waiting = false;

    while (!waiting && (m->turn_next < m->turn_count))
    {
        const uint8_t next = m->turn_next;

        if (m->turns[next].after != X430_TURN_NOW)
        {
            waiting = true;
        }
        else if (x430_group_read(m, m->turns[next].device, m->turns[next].address,
                                 m->turns[next].length))
        {
            m->turn_next++;
        }
        else
        {
            /* Silent device (Status Return Level 0): no device after it hears its turn. */
            x430_turn_cancel(m);
        }
    }
    m->turn_ms = x430_millis(m);
}

static void x430_turn_heard(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, uint8_t id)
{
    if (m->turn_next < m->turn_count)
    {
        struct x430_turn* turn = &m->turns[m->turn_next];

        if ((x430_millis(m) - m->turn_ms) > X430_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS_U)
        {
            /* The read stalled (a device before is missing): stay silent. */
            x430_turn_cancel(m);
        }
        else if (turn->after == id)
        {
            turn->after = X430_TURN_NOW;
            x430_turn_run(m);
        }
        else
        {
            /* An earlier device of the read answered: the read makes progress. */
            m->turn_ms = x430_millis(m);
        }
    }
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: SINGLE-DEVICE INSTRUCTIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static bool x430_factory_reset_check(const struct dxl2_packet* packet, enum x430_target target,
                                     uint8_t* error)
{
    const uint8_t option = packet->parameters[0];
    bool run = false;

    if (packet->parameter_length != 1U)
    {
        *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
    }
    else if ((option != X430_FACTORY_RESET_ALL) && (option != X430_FACTORY_RESET_EXCEPT_ID) &&
             (option != X430_FACTORY_RESET_EXCEPT_ID_BAUD))
    {
        *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
    }
    else if (((target == X430_TARGET_BROADCAST) && (option == X430_FACTORY_RESET_ALL)) ||
             (target == X430_TARGET_SECONDARY))
    {
        /* Reset All is refused on the broadcast ID; the Secondary ID cannot touch EEPROM. */
        *error = DXL2_ERR_ACCESS;
    }
    else
    {
        run = true;
    }
    return run;
}

static uint16_t x430_instruction(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, struct x430_device* device,
                                 const struct dxl2_packet* packet, enum x430_target target,
                                 uint8_t* error, bool* answer_first)
{
    const uint16_t count = packet->parameter_length;
    const uint8_t* parameters = packet->parameters;
    uint8_t options = 0U;
    uint16_t length = 0U;

    if (target == X430_TARGET_SECONDARY)
    {
        options = X430_WRITE_SECONDARY;
    }

    switch (packet->instruction)
    {
        case DXL2_INST_PING:
            dxl2_put_u16(&m->tx[X430_TX_DATA],
                         (uint16_t)x430_device_value(device, X430_ADDR_MODEL_NUMBER));
            m->tx[X430_TX_DATA + 2U] = x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_FIRMWARE_VERSION);
            length = 3U;
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_READ:
            if (count != X430_READ_PARAMS)
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
            }
            else
            {
                length = dxl2_get_u16(&parameters[2]);
                if (length > X430_STATUS_DATA_MAX)
                {
                    *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
                }
                else
                {
                    (void)x430_device_read(device, dxl2_get_u16(parameters), length,
                                           &m->tx[X430_TX_DATA], error);
                }
            }
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_WRITE:
            if (count <= X430_WRITE_HEADER)
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
            }
            else
            {
                (void)x430_device_write(device, dxl2_get_u16(parameters),
                                        (uint16_t)(count - X430_WRITE_HEADER),
                                        &parameters[X430_WRITE_HEADER], options, error);
            }
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_REG_WRITE:
            if (count <= X430_WRITE_HEADER)
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
            }
            else
            {
                (void)x430_device_reg_write(device, dxl2_get_u16(parameters),
                                            (uint16_t)(count - X430_WRITE_HEADER),
                                            &parameters[X430_WRITE_HEADER], options, error);
            }
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_ACTION:
            if (count == 0U)
            {
                (void)x430_device_action(device, error);
            }
            else
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
            }
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_REBOOT:
            if (count == 0U)
            {
                *answer_first = true;
            }
            else
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
            }
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_FACTORY_RESET:
            *answer_first = x430_factory_reset_check(packet, target, error);
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_CLEAR:
            if ((count == X430_OPTION_PARAMS) &&
                x430_magic_ok(parameters, 0x44U, 0x58U, 0x4CU, 0x22U))
            {
                (void)x430_device_clear(device, parameters[0], error);
            }
            else
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
            }
            break;
#if X430_FEATURE_BACKUP
        case DXL2_INST_BACKUP:
            if ((count == X430_OPTION_PARAMS) &&
                x430_magic_ok(parameters, (uint8_t)'C', (uint8_t)'T', (uint8_t)'R', (uint8_t)'L'))
            {
                (void)x430_device_backup(device, parameters[0], error);
            }
            else
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
            }
            break;
#endif
        default:
            *error = DXL2_ERR_INSTRUCTION;
            break;
    }
    return length;
}

static void x430_execute(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, struct x430_device* device,
                         const struct dxl2_packet* packet, enum x430_target target)
{
    const uint8_t id = x430_id_of(device);
    uint8_t error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;
    bool answer_first = false; /* REBOOT/FACTORY_RESET answer before they act. */
    const uint16_t length = x430_instruction(m, device, packet, target, &error, &answer_first);
    bool answer = false;

    if (target == X430_TARGET_PRIMARY)
    {
        uint8_t needed = X430_LEVEL_ALL;

        if (packet->instruction == DXL2_INST_PING)
        {
            needed = X430_LEVEL_PING;
        }
        else if (packet->instruction == DXL2_INST_READ)
        {
            needed = X430_LEVEL_READ;
        }
        else
        {
            /* Every other instruction answers at level 2 only. */
        }
        answer = x430_answers(device, needed);
    }
    else if (target == X430_TARGET_BROADCAST)
    {
        answer = packet->instruction == DXL2_INST_PING;
    }
    else
    {
        /* Secondary ID: never answers. */
    }
    if (answer)
    {
        x430_send_status(m, device, id, error, length);
    }

    /* x430_instruction() sets answer_first only for an instruction without error */
    if (answer_first)
    {
        if (packet->instruction == DXL2_INST_REBOOT)
        {
            (void)x430_device_reboot(device);
        }
        else
        {
            (void)x430_device_factory_reset(device, packet->parameters[0], &error);
        }
    }
    (void)x430_device_flush_events(device);
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: GROUP INSTRUCTIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static void x430_sync_read(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    if (packet->parameter_length > X430_READ_PARAMS)
    {
        const uint16_t address = dxl2_get_u16(packet->parameters);
        const uint16_t length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[2]);

        if ((length != 0U) && (length <= X430_STATUS_DATA_MAX))
        {
            uint8_t after = X430_TURN_NOW;

            for (uint16_t index = X430_READ_PARAMS; index < packet->parameter_length; index++)
            {
                x430_turn_add(m, packet->parameters[index], address, length, &after);
            }
            x430_turn_run(m);
        }
    }
}

static void x430_sync_write(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    if (packet->parameter_length > X430_READ_PARAMS)
    {
        const uint16_t address = dxl2_get_u16(packet->parameters);
        const uint16_t length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[2]);
        const uint32_t entry = (uint32_t)length + 1U;
        const uint32_t body = (uint32_t)packet->parameter_length - X430_READ_PARAMS;

        if ((length != 0U) && ((body % entry) == 0U))
        {
            for (uint32_t index = X430_READ_PARAMS; index < packet->parameter_length;
                 index += entry)
            {
                struct x430_device* device = x430_find(m, packet->parameters[index]);

                if (device != NULL)
                {
                    uint8_t error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

                    (void)x430_device_write(device, address, length,
                                            &packet->parameters[index + 1U], 0U, &error);
                    (void)x430_device_flush_events(device);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#if X430_FEATURE_BULK

static void x430_bulk_read(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    if ((packet->parameter_length != 0U) &&
        ((packet->parameter_length % X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY) == 0U))
    {
        uint8_t after = X430_TURN_NOW;

        for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < packet->parameter_length;
             index = (uint16_t)(index + X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY))
        {
            const uint8_t id = packet->parameters[index];
            const uint16_t length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 3U]);

            if ((length != 0U) && (length <= X430_STATUS_DATA_MAX))
            {
                x430_turn_add(m, id, dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 1U]), length, &after);
            }
            else
            {
                /* Not answered: the entry after it waits for a status that never comes. */
                after = id;
            }
        }
        x430_turn_run(m);
    }
}

static void x430_bulk_write(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    uint32_t index = 0U;
    bool valid = true;

    /* Validate the whole packet first: a malformed entry voids the instruction. */
    while (valid && (index < packet->parameter_length))
    {
        if ((index + X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY) > packet->parameter_length)
        {
            valid = false;
        }
        else
        {
            const uint16_t length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 3U]);

            valid = (length != 0U) &&
                    ((index + X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY + length) <= packet->parameter_length);
            index += X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY + (uint32_t)length;
        }
    }

    index = 0U;
    while (valid && (index < packet->parameter_length))
    {
        struct x430_device* device = x430_find(m, packet->parameters[index]);
        const uint16_t length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 3U]);

        if (device != NULL)
        {
            uint8_t error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

            (void)x430_device_write(device, dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 1U]), length,
                                    &packet->parameters[index + X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY], 0U, &error);
            (void)x430_device_flush_events(device);
        }
        index += X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY + (uint32_t)length;
    }
}

#endif /* X430_FEATURE_BULK */

#if X430_FEATURE_FAST_READ

static void x430_fast_read(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet, bool bulk)
{
    uint16_t ends[X430_MAX_DEVICES];
    const struct x430_device* first = NULL;
    uint32_t position = X430_FAST_HEADER;
    uint8_t segments = 0U;
    uint16_t step = 1U;
    uint16_t start = X430_READ_PARAMS;
    bool valid = packet->parameter_length > X430_READ_PARAMS;

    if (bulk)
    {
        step = X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY;
        start = 0U;
        valid = (packet->parameter_length != 0U) &&
                ((packet->parameter_length % X430_BULK_READ_ENTRY) == 0U);
    }

    uint16_t index = start;

    while (valid && (index < packet->parameter_length))
    {
        const uint8_t id = packet->parameters[index];
        uint16_t address = dxl2_get_u16(packet->parameters);
        uint16_t length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[2]);
        struct x430_device* device = x430_find(m, id);

        if (bulk)
        {
            address = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 1U]);
            length = dxl2_get_u16(&packet->parameters[index + 3U]);
        }

        if ((length == 0U) || (device == NULL) ||
            ((position + length + X430_FAST_SEGMENT_OVERHEAD) > DXL2_MAX_PACKET_SIZE))
        {
            /* Malformed, or an ID of another bus: the answer of several buses would have
               to be one chained packet, which this bus cannot build. It stays silent, and
               the host falls back to SYNC_READ / BULK_READ. */
            valid = false;
        }
        else if ((segments < X430_MAX_DEVICES_U) && x430_answers(device, X430_LEVEL_READ))
        {
            uint8_t error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;
            uint8_t* data = &m->tx[position + 2U];

            (void)x430_device_read(device, address, length, data, &error);
            if (error != DXL2_ERR_NONE)
            {
                x430_fill(data, 0U, length);
            }
            m->tx[position] = (uint8_t)(error | x430_device_alert(device));
            m->tx[position + 1U] = id;
            ends[segments] = (uint16_t)(position + 2U + length);
            position = (uint32_t)ends[segments] + 2U;
            segments++;
            if (first == NULL)
            {
                first = device;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* Silent device (Status Return Level 0), or listed more than once: skipped. */
        }
        index = (uint16_t)(index + step);
    }

    if (valid && (first != NULL))
    {
        m->tx[0] = 0xFFU;
        m->tx[1] = 0xFFU;
        m->tx[2] = 0xFDU;
        m->tx[3] = 0x00U;
        m->tx[4] = DXL2_BROADCAST_ID;
        dxl2_put_u16(&m->tx[5], (uint16_t)(position - 7U));
        m->tx[7] = DXL2_INST_STATUS;
        for (uint8_t segment = 0U; segment < segments; segment++)
        {
            dxl2_put_u16(&m->tx[ends[segment]], dxl2_crc16(m->tx, ends[segment]));
        }
        x430_delay_status(m, first);
        x430_write_tx(m, (size_t)position);
    }
}

#endif /* X430_FEATURE_FAST_READ */

static void x430_broadcast_ping(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    int16_t last = -1;

    for (uint8_t round = 0U; round < m->device_count; round++)
    {
        struct x430_device* next = NULL;
        int16_t next_id = 256;

        for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
        {
            struct x430_device* device = m->devices[index];
            const int16_t id = (int16_t)x430_id_of(device);

            if ((id > last) && (id < next_id))
            {
                next = device;
                next_id = id;
            }
        }
        /* FACTORY_RESET (all) may give two devices the same ID: the second one stays silent. */
        if (next != NULL)
        {
            last = next_id;
            x430_execute(m, next, packet, X430_TARGET_BROADCAST);
        }
    }
}

static void x430_broadcast(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    switch (packet->instruction)
    {
        case DXL2_INST_PING:
            x430_broadcast_ping(m, packet);
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_SYNC_READ:
            x430_sync_read(m, packet);
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_SYNC_WRITE:
            x430_sync_write(m, packet);
            break;
#if X430_FEATURE_BULK
        case DXL2_INST_BULK_READ:
            x430_bulk_read(m, packet);
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_BULK_WRITE:
            x430_bulk_write(m, packet);
            break;
#endif
#if X430_FEATURE_FAST_READ
        case DXL2_INST_FAST_SYNC_READ:
            x430_fast_read(m, packet, false);
            break;
        case DXL2_INST_FAST_BULK_READ:
            x430_fast_read(m, packet, true);
            break;
#endif
        case DXL2_INST_WRITE:
        case DXL2_INST_REG_WRITE:
        case DXL2_INST_ACTION:
        case DXL2_INST_FACTORY_RESET:
        case DXL2_INST_REBOOT:
        case DXL2_INST_CLEAR:
        case DXL2_INST_BACKUP:
            for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
            {
                x430_execute(m, m->devices[index], packet, X430_TARGET_BROADCAST);
            }
            break;
        default:
            /* READ and unknown instructions on the broadcast ID: no device answers. */
            break;
    }
}

static void x430_dispatch(struct x430_bus_ctx* m, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    if (packet->instruction != DXL2_INST_STATUS)
    {
        const uint32_t now = x430_millis(m);

        /* A new instruction ends a read that still waits for its turn. */
        x430_turn_cancel(m);
        for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
        {
            x430_device_watchdog(m->devices[index], now - m->last_rx_ms);
        }
        m->last_rx_ms = now;

        if (packet->id == DXL2_BROADCAST_ID)
        {
            x430_broadcast(m, packet);
        }
        else
        {
            /* The primary ID answers; devices sharing it as Secondary ID act silently. */
            for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
            {
                struct x430_device* device = m->devices[index];
                const uint8_t secondary = x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_SECONDARY_ID);

                if (x430_id_of(device) == packet->id)
                {
                    x430_execute(m, device, packet, X430_TARGET_PRIMARY);
                }
                else if ((secondary == packet->id) && (secondary < X430_SECONDARY_ID_DISABLED))
                {
                    x430_execute(m, device, packet, X430_TARGET_SECONDARY);
                }
                else
                {
                    /* Not addressed. */
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        /* Status packet of another device on the shared bus (or the echo of our own). */
        x430_turn_heard(m, packet->id);
    }
}

static void x430_handler(const struct dxl2_packet* packet, void* context)
{
    /* cppcheck-suppress misra-c2012-11.5 ; DEV-02 callback context */
    x430_dispatch((struct x430_bus_ctx*)context, packet);
}

static int x430_check(const struct x430_bus* bus)
{
    const struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of_const(bus);
    int result = X430_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != X430_READY)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        /* Ready. */
    }
    return result;
}

static int x430_take_write_result(struct x430_bus_ctx* m)
{
    int result = X430_OK;

    if (m->write_failed)
    {
        m->write_failed = false;
        result = X430_ERR_HAL;
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * INTERNAL FUNCTIONS (x430_internal.h)
 * =============================================================================*/

size_t x430_frame_status(uint8_t* tx, size_t capacity, uint8_t id, uint16_t count)
{
    uint32_t end = X430_TX_DATA + (uint32_t)count;
    uint32_t stuffing = 0U;
    uint32_t from = 0U;
    uint32_t to = 0U;

    tx[X430_TX_BODY] = DXL2_INST_STATUS;
    for (uint32_t index = X430_TX_DATA; index < end; index++)
    {
        if (x430_stuffed_at(tx, index))
        {
            stuffing++;
        }
    }
    if (((size_t)end + stuffing + 2U) > capacity)
    {
        /* The stuffed data does not fit: Data Length Error without data (alert bit kept). */
        tx[X430_TX_ERROR] =
            (uint8_t)((tx[X430_TX_ERROR] & DXL2_ERR_ALERT_BIT) | DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH);
        end = X430_TX_DATA;
        stuffing = 0U;
    }

    /* Moves each byte up by the stuffing still to insert below it; reads stay below writes. */
    from = end;
    to = end + stuffing;
    while (to > from)
    {
        from--;
        if (x430_stuffed_at(tx, from))
        {
            to--;
            tx[to] = X430_STUFFING;
        }
        to--;
        tx[to] = tx[from];
    }
    tx[0] = 0xFFU;
    tx[1] = 0xFFU;
    tx[2] = 0xFDU;
    tx[3] = 0x00U;
    tx[4] = id;
    dxl2_put_u16(&tx[X430_TX_LENGTH], (uint16_t)((end + stuffing + 2U) - X430_TX_BODY));
    dxl2_put_u16(&tx[end + stuffing], dxl2_crc16(tx, (size_t)end + stuffing));
    return (size_t)end + stuffing + 2U;
}

bool x430_bus_id_taken(const struct x430_bus* bus, const struct x430_device* except, uint8_t id)
{
    bool taken = false;

    if (bus != NULL)
    {
        const struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of_const(bus);

        for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
        {
            if ((m->devices[index] != except) && (x430_id_of(m->devices[index]) == id))
            {
                taken = true;
            }
        }
    }
    return taken;
}

uint32_t x430_bus_millis(const struct x430_bus* bus)
{
    uint32_t now = 0U;

    if (bus != NULL)
    {
        now = x430_millis(x430_bus_ctx_of_const(bus));
    }
    return now;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

int x430_bus_init(struct x430_bus* bus, const struct x430_bus_config* config)
{
    struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of(bus);
    int result = X430_OK;

    if ((m == NULL) || (config == NULL))
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (config->write == NULL)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        /* Receive only: the bus frames its status packets in tx[] itself, so that no
           packet-sized buffer is needed on the stack (dxl2_link_send() has one). */
        const struct dxl2_link_config link = {
            .write = NULL,
            .write_context = NULL,
            .handler = x430_handler,
            .handler_context = m,
        };

        /* Field by field (no temporary copy of the context); devices[] is read only below
           device_count, tx[] is written before it is sent. */
        m->config = *config;
        m->device_count = 0U;
        m->write_failed = false;
        x430_turn_cancel(m);
        (void)dxl2_link_init(&m->link, &link);
        m->last_rx_ms = x430_millis(m);
        m->turn_ms = m->last_rx_ms;
        m->ready = X430_READY;
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_attach(struct x430_bus* bus, struct x430_device* device)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if ((result == X430_OK) && (device == NULL))
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of(bus);

        if (!x430_device_ready(device) || (x430_device_bus(device) != NULL))
        {
            result = X430_ERR_STATE;
        }
        else if ((m->device_count >= X430_MAX_DEVICES_U) ||
                 x430_bus_id_taken(bus, NULL, x430_id_of(device)))
        {
            result = X430_ERR_CONFIG;
        }
        else
        {
            x430_lock(m);
            m->devices[m->device_count] = device;
            m->device_count++;
            x430_device_attach(device, bus);
            x430_unlock(m);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        /* Bus not usable: result from x430_check(). */
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_receive(struct x430_bus* bus, const uint8_t* data, size_t length)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if ((result == X430_OK) && (data == NULL) && (length != 0U))
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of(bus);

        x430_lock(m);
        dxl2_link_receive(&m->link, data, length);
        result = x430_take_write_result(m);
        x430_unlock(m);
    }
    else
    {
        /* Bus not usable: result from x430_check(). */
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_handle_packet(struct x430_bus* bus, const struct dxl2_packet* packet)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if ((result == X430_OK) && (packet == NULL))
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of(bus);

        x430_lock(m);
        x430_dispatch(m, packet);
        result = x430_take_write_result(m);
        x430_unlock(m);
    }
    else
    {
        /* Bus not usable: result from x430_check(). */
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_poll(struct x430_bus* bus)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_bus_ctx* m = x430_bus_ctx_of(bus);
        uint32_t idle = 0U;

        x430_lock(m);
        idle = x430_millis(m) - m->last_rx_ms;
        for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < m->device_count; index++)
        {
            x430_device_watchdog(m->devices[index], idle);
        }
        x430_unlock(m);
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_lock(struct x430_bus* bus)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        x430_lock(x430_bus_ctx_of_const(bus));
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_unlock(struct x430_bus* bus)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        x430_unlock(x430_bus_ctx_of_const(bus));
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_bus_find(const struct x430_bus* bus, uint8_t id, struct x430_device** device)
{
    int result = x430_check(bus);

    if (device == NULL)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        *device = NULL;
        if (result == X430_OK)
        {
            *device = x430_find(x430_bus_ctx_of_const(bus), id);
            if (*device == NULL)
            {
                result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * INCLUDES
 * =============================================================================*/

#include "x430.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "x430_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define X430_NVM_FORMAT 1U
#define X430_NVM_CHUNK 16U
#define X430_CRC_POLYNOMIAL 0x8005U
#define X430_TOUCHED_BYTES ((X430_REGISTER_COUNT + 7U) / 8U)
#define X430_PULSES_PER_TURN 4096
#define X430_ID_MAX 252U

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE TYPE DEFINITIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

/* Alignment probes: sizeof(probe) - sizeof(x) is the alignment of the type of x
   (no _Alignof, Rule 1.4; no offsetof, which the static analysis cannot resolve) */
struct x430_align_device_ctx
{
    char c;
    struct x430_device_ctx x;
};

struct x430_align_device
{
    char c;
    struct x430_device x;
};

/* The opaque public instance must hold the private state */
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct x430_device_ctx) <= sizeof(struct x430_device),
               "X430_DEVICE_BYTES in x430_types.h is too small for this ABI");
_Static_assert((sizeof(struct x430_align_device_ctx) - sizeof(struct x430_device_ctx)) <=
                   (sizeof(struct x430_align_device) - sizeof(struct x430_device)),
               "struct x430_device is not aligned for struct x430_device_ctx");

/* Every fixed address the library uses is in the direct part of the image */
_Static_assert(X430_ADDR_BACKUP_READY < X430_IMAGE_DIRECT,
               "the first image segment must hold every register below the indirect blocks");

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: RAW ACCESS
 * =============================================================================*/

static uint16_t x430_slot(uint16_t address)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;
    uint16_t slot = X430_IMAGE_SIZE;

    for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < model->segment_count; index++)
    {
        const struct x430_segment* segment = &model->segments[index];

        if ((address >= segment->address) &&
            ((uint32_t)address < ((uint32_t)segment->address + segment->length)))
        {
            slot = (uint16_t)(((uint32_t)address - segment->address) + segment->offset);
        }
    }
    return slot;
}

static uint8_t x430_peek(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t address)
{
    const uint16_t slot = x430_slot(address);
    uint8_t value = 0U;

    if (slot < X430_IMAGE_SIZE)
    {
        value = m->table[slot];
    }
    return value;
}

static uint32_t x430_raw_get(const uint8_t* table, uint16_t address, uint8_t size)
{
    uint32_t value = 0U;
    uint8_t index = size;

    while (index > 0U)
    {
        index--;
        value = (value << 8) | (uint32_t)table[address + index];
    }
    return value;
}

static void x430_raw_put(uint8_t* table, uint16_t address, uint8_t size, uint32_t value)
{
    uint32_t remaining = value;

    for (uint8_t index = 0U; index < size; index++)
    {
        table[address + index] = (uint8_t)(remaining & 0xFFU);
        remaining >>= 8;
    }
}

static int32_t x430_to_value(const struct x430_reg* reg, uint32_t raw)
{
    uint32_t extended = raw;

    if (((reg->flags & X430_REG_SIGNED) != 0U) && (reg->size < 4U))
    {
        const uint32_t bits = (uint32_t)reg->size * 8U;
        const uint32_t sign = (uint32_t)1U << (bits - 1U);

        if ((raw & sign) != 0U)
        {
            extended = raw | ~((sign << 1) - 1U);
        }
    }
    return (int32_t)extended;
}

static void x430_indirect_reg(const struct x430_indirect_block* block, uint32_t entry,
                              struct x430_reg* reg)
{
    reg->address = (uint16_t)((uint32_t)block->address + (2U * entry));
    reg->size = 2U;
    reg->flags = (uint8_t)(X430_REG_WRITABLE | X430_REG_CHECK(X430_CHECK_INDIRECT));
    reg->initial = (int32_t)block->data + (int32_t)entry;
    reg->min = (int32_t)X430_RAM_START;
    reg->max = (int32_t)X430_TABLE_SIZE - 1;
}

static struct x430_reg x430_reg_by_index(uint16_t index)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;
    struct x430_reg reg;

    if (index < model->register_count)
    {
        reg = model->registers[index];
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t entry = (uint32_t)index - model->register_count;
        uint8_t block = 0U;

        /* index < X430_REGISTER_COUNT: the entry lies in one of the blocks */
        while (entry >= model->indirect[block].count)
        {
            entry -= model->indirect[block].count;
            block++;
        }
        x430_indirect_reg(&model->indirect[block], entry, &reg);
    }
    return reg;
}

static uint16_t x430_reg_find(uint16_t address, struct x430_reg* reg)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;
    uint16_t low = 0U;
    uint16_t high = model->register_count;
    uint32_t first = model->register_count;
    uint16_t number = X430_REGISTER_COUNT;

    while (low < high)
    {
        const uint16_t middle = (uint16_t)(((uint32_t)low + high) / 2U);

        if (model->registers[middle].address <= address)
        {
            low = (uint16_t)(middle + 1U);
        }
        else
        {
            high = middle;
        }
    }
    /* registers[low - 1] is the last register that starts at or below address */
    if ((uint32_t)address <
        ((uint32_t)model->registers[low - 1U].address + model->registers[low - 1U].size))
    {
        *reg = model->registers[low - 1U];
        number = (uint16_t)(low - 1U);
    }
    for (uint8_t block = 0U; block < model->indirect_count; block++)
    {
        const struct x430_indirect_block* entry = &model->indirect[block];
        const uint32_t end = (uint32_t)entry->address + (2U * (uint32_t)entry->count);

        if ((address >= entry->address) && ((uint32_t)address < end))
        {
            const uint32_t slot = ((uint32_t)address - entry->address) / 2U;

            x430_indirect_reg(entry, slot, reg);
            number = (uint16_t)(first + slot);
        }
        first += entry->count;
    }
    return number;
}

static bool x430_reg_start(uint16_t address, struct x430_reg* reg)
{
    return (x430_reg_find(address, reg) < X430_REGISTER_COUNT) && (reg->address == address);
}

static int32_t x430_reg_value(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, const struct x430_reg* reg)
{
    return x430_to_value(reg, x430_raw_get(m->table, x430_slot(reg->address), reg->size));
}

static void x430_reg_store(struct x430_device_ctx* m, const struct x430_reg* reg, int32_t value)
{
    x430_raw_put(m->table, x430_slot(reg->address), reg->size, (uint32_t)value);
}

static int32_t x430_get(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t address)
{
    struct x430_reg reg;
    int32_t value = 0;

    if (x430_reg_start(address, &reg))
    {
        value = x430_reg_value(m, &reg);
    }
    return value;
}

static void x430_put(struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t address, int32_t value)
{
    struct x430_reg reg;

    if (x430_reg_start(address, &reg))
    {
        x430_reg_store(m, &reg, value);
    }
}

static uint16_t x430_resolve(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t address)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;
    uint16_t resolved = address;

    for (uint8_t block = 0U; block < model->indirect_count; block++)
    {
        const struct x430_indirect_block* entry = &model->indirect[block];
        const uint32_t end = (uint32_t)entry->data + entry->count;

        if ((address >= entry->data) && ((uint32_t)address < end))
        {
            const uint32_t offset = 2U * ((uint32_t)address - entry->data);
            const uint16_t slot = x430_slot((uint16_t)((uint32_t)entry->address + offset));
            const uint16_t target = (uint16_t)x430_raw_get(m->table, slot, 2U);

            /* Writes are range checked (X430_CHECK_INDIRECT), x430_device_set() is not. */
            if (target < X430_TABLE_SIZE)
            {
                resolved = target;
            }
        }
    }
    return resolved;
}

static bool x430_touches_indirect(uint16_t address, uint16_t length)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;
    bool touches = false;
    const uint32_t end = (uint32_t)address + length;

    for (uint8_t block = 0U; block < model->indirect_count; block++)
    {
        const struct x430_indirect_block* entry = &model->indirect[block];
        const uint32_t block_end = (uint32_t)entry->data + entry->count;

        if (((uint32_t)address < block_end) && (end > entry->data))
        {
            touches = true;
        }
    }
    return touches;
}

static uint8_t x430_event(struct x430_device* device, enum x430_event event)
{
    const struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of_const(device);
    const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;
    uint8_t result = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

    if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->event != NULL))
    {
        result = hooks->event(device, event, m->config.user_data);
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: PERSISTENCE
 * =============================================================================*/

static uint16_t x430_crc16(uint16_t crc, const uint8_t* data, uint16_t length)
{
    uint16_t value = crc;

    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
    {
        value ^= (uint16_t)((uint32_t)data[index] << 8);
        for (uint8_t bit = 0U; bit < 8U; bit++)
        {
            if ((value & 0x8000U) != 0U)
            {
                value = (uint16_t)(((uint32_t)value << 1) ^ X430_CRC_POLYNOMIAL);
            }
            else
            {
                value = (uint16_t)((uint32_t)value << 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return value;
}

static void x430_nvm_header(uint8_t* header, enum x430_nvm_slot slot, uint16_t size)
{
    header[0] = (uint8_t)'X';
    header[1] = (uint8_t)'4';
    header[2] = (uint8_t)'3';
    header[3] = (uint8_t)'0';
    dxl2_put_u16(&header[4], x430_model_active.model_number);
    header[6] = (uint8_t)X430_NVM_FORMAT;
    header[7] = (uint8_t)slot;
    dxl2_put_u16(&header[8], size);
}

static bool x430_nvm_read(struct x430_device* device, enum x430_nvm_slot slot, uint16_t offset,
                          uint8_t* data, uint16_t length)
{
    const struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of_const(device);

    return m->config.hooks->nvm_read(device, slot, offset, data, length, m->config.user_data) == 0;
}

static bool x430_nvm_valid(struct x430_device* device, enum x430_nvm_slot slot, uint16_t size)
{
    const struct x430_hooks* hooks = x430_device_ctx_of_const(device)->config.hooks;
    bool valid = false;

    if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->nvm_read != NULL))
    {
        uint8_t expected[X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE];
        uint8_t chunk[X430_NVM_CHUNK];
        uint16_t crc = 0U;
        uint16_t done = 0U;

        x430_nvm_header(expected, slot, size);
        valid = x430_nvm_read(device, slot, 0U, chunk, X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE);
        for (uint8_t index = 0U; valid && (index < X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE); index++)
        {
            valid = chunk[index] == expected[index];
        }
        crc = x430_crc16(0U, expected, X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE);
        while (valid && (done < size))
        {
            uint16_t part = (uint16_t)(size - done);

            if (part > X430_NVM_CHUNK)
            {
                part = X430_NVM_CHUNK;
            }
            valid =
                x430_nvm_read(device, slot, (uint16_t)(X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE + done), chunk, part);
            crc = x430_crc16(crc, chunk, part);
            done = (uint16_t)(done + part);
        }
        if (valid)
        {
            valid =
                x430_nvm_read(device, slot, (uint16_t)(X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE + size), chunk, 2U) &&
                (dxl2_get_u16(chunk) == crc);
        }
    }
    return valid;
}

static void x430_nvm_apply(struct x430_device* device, enum x430_nvm_slot slot,
                           const struct x430_reg* reg)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    const uint16_t index = x430_slot(reg->address);
    uint8_t bytes[4] = {0U, 0U, 0U, 0U};

    if (x430_nvm_read(device, slot, (uint16_t)(X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE + index), bytes, reg->size))
    {
        x430_copy(&m->table[index], bytes, reg->size);
    }
}

static uint8_t x430_nvm_store(struct x430_device* device, enum x430_nvm_slot slot, uint16_t size)
{
    const struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of_const(device);
    const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;
    uint8_t result = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

    if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->nvm_write != NULL))
    {
        uint8_t header[X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE];
        uint8_t crc[2];
        int written = 0;

        x430_nvm_header(header, slot, size);
        dxl2_put_u16(crc, x430_crc16(x430_crc16(0U, header, X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE), m->table, size));
        written =
            hooks->nvm_write(device, slot, 0U, header, X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE, m->config.user_data);
        if (written == 0)
        {
            written = hooks->nvm_write(device, slot, X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE, m->table, size,
                                       m->config.user_data);
        }
        if (written == 0)
        {
            written = hooks->nvm_write(device, slot, (uint16_t)(X430_NVM_HEADER_SIZE + size), crc,
                                       2U, m->config.user_data);
        }
        if (written != 0)
        {
            result = DXL2_ERR_RESULT_FAIL;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

static void x430_apply_eeprom(struct x430_device* device)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;

    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < model->register_count; index++)
    {
        const struct x430_reg* reg = &model->registers[index];

        if (((reg->flags & X430_REG_WRITABLE) != 0U) && ((reg->flags & X430_REG_EEPROM) != 0U))
        {
            x430_nvm_apply(device, X430_NVM_EEPROM, reg);
        }
    }
}

#if X430_FEATURE_BACKUP
static void x430_apply_backup(struct x430_device* device, bool ram_only)
{
    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < X430_REGISTER_COUNT; index++)
    {
        const struct x430_reg reg = x430_reg_by_index(index);
        const bool identity = (reg.address == X430_ADDR_ID) ||
                              (reg.address == X430_ADDR_BAUD_RATE) ||
                              (reg.address == X430_ADDR_PROTOCOL_TYPE);
        const bool runtime =
            (reg.address == X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE) || (reg.address == X430_ADDR_BUS_WATCHDOG);
        const bool eeprom = (reg.flags & X430_REG_EEPROM) != 0U;

        if (((reg.flags & X430_REG_WRITABLE) != 0U) && !runtime && !identity &&
            (!ram_only || !eeprom))
        {
            x430_nvm_apply(device, X430_NVM_BACKUP, &reg);
        }
    }
}
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: CHECKS
 * =============================================================================*/

static bool x430_torque_on(const struct x430_device_ctx* m)
{
    return m->table[X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE] != 0U;
}

static int32_t x430_abs(int32_t value)
{
    int32_t magnitude = value;

    if (value < 0)
    {
        magnitude = -value;
    }
    return magnitude;
}

static bool x430_check_value(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, const struct x430_reg* reg,
                             int32_t value)
{
    const struct x430_model* model = &x430_model_active;
    bool valid = false;

    /* tools/x430_gen_model.py gives every writable register a check other than NONE */
    switch ((uint8_t)((uint32_t)reg->flags >> X430_REG_CHECK_SHIFT))
    {
        case (uint8_t)X430_CHECK_MASK:
            valid = (((uint32_t)value) & ~((uint32_t)reg->max)) == 0U;
            break;
        case (uint8_t)X430_CHECK_OPMODE:
            /* Operating Mode is one unsigned byte: value is 0..255 */
            if ((uint32_t)value < 32U)
            {
                valid = (model->operating_modes & ((uint32_t)1U << (uint32_t)value)) != 0U;
            }
            break;
        case (uint8_t)X430_CHECK_SYMMETRIC:
            valid = x430_abs(value) <= x430_get(m, (uint16_t)reg->max);
            break;
        case (uint8_t)X430_CHECK_GOAL_POSITION:
            if (m->table[X430_ADDR_OPERATING_MODE] == X430_MODE_POSITION)
            {
                valid = (value >= x430_get(m, X430_ADDR_MIN_POSITION_LIMIT)) &&
                        (value <= x430_get(m, X430_ADDR_MAX_POSITION_LIMIT));
            }
            else
            {
                valid = x430_abs(value) <= X430_EXTENDED_POSITION_LIMIT;
            }
            break;
        default:
            /* X430_CHECK_RANGE and X430_CHECK_INDIRECT */
            valid = (value >= reg->min) && (value <= reg->max);
            break;
    }
    return valid;
}

static uint8_t x430_check_write(const struct x430_device* device, const struct x430_reg* reg,
                                int32_t value, uint8_t options)
{
    const struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of_const(device);
    uint8_t result = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

    if ((reg->flags & X430_REG_WRITABLE) == 0U)
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_ACCESS;
    }
    else if (((reg->flags & X430_REG_EEPROM) != 0U) &&
             (x430_torque_on(m) || ((options & X430_WRITE_SECONDARY) != 0U)))
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_ACCESS;
    }
    else if (((reg->flags & X430_REG_GOAL) != 0U) &&
             (m->table[X430_ADDR_BUS_WATCHDOG] == X430_BUS_WATCHDOG_ERROR))
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
    }
    else if (reg->address == X430_ADDR_BAUD_RATE)
    {
        /* The model table says 0..7; applications may allow their own codes. Baud Rate
           is one unsigned byte: value is 0..255. */
        if ((uint32_t)value > X430_BAUD_RATE_CODE_MAX_U)
        {
            result = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
        }
    }
    else if (!x430_check_value(m, reg, value))
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
    }
    else if ((reg->address == X430_ADDR_ID) && x430_bus_id_taken(m->bus, device, (uint8_t)value))
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
    }
    else if ((reg->address == X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE) && (value != 0) &&
             ((m->table[X430_ADDR_HARDWARE_ERROR_STATUS] & m->table[X430_ADDR_SHUTDOWN]) != 0U))
    {
        /* After a shutdown only REBOOT re-enables the torque. */
        result = DXL2_ERR_RESULT_FAIL;
    }
    else
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_NONE;
    }
    return result;
}

static uint32_t x430_merge(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, const struct x430_reg* reg,
                           uint16_t address, uint16_t length, const uint8_t* data, bool indirect)
{
    uint8_t bytes[4] = {0U, 0U, 0U, 0U};
    const uint32_t end = (uint32_t)address + length;
    const uint32_t reg_end = (uint32_t)reg->address + reg->size;

    x430_copy(bytes, &m->table[x430_slot(reg->address)], reg->size);
    if (!indirect)
    {
        for (uint8_t offset = 0U; offset < reg->size; offset++)
        {
            const uint32_t target = (uint32_t)reg->address + offset;

            if ((target >= address) && (target < end))
            {
                bytes[offset] = data[target - address];
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
        {
            const uint16_t target = x430_resolve(m, (uint16_t)((uint32_t)address + index));

            if ((target >= reg->address) && ((uint32_t)target < reg_end))
            {
                bytes[target - reg->address] = data[index];
            }
        }
    }
    return x430_raw_get(bytes, 0U, reg->size);
}

static void x430_mark_touched(const struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t address, uint16_t length,
                              uint8_t* touched, bool indirect)
{
    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
    {
        const uint16_t raw = (uint16_t)((uint32_t)address + index);
        uint16_t target = raw;
        struct x430_reg reg;
        uint16_t number = 0U;

        if (indirect)
        {
            target = x430_resolve(m, raw);
        }
        number = x430_reg_find(target, &reg);
        if (number < X430_REGISTER_COUNT)
        {
            const uint16_t byte = number / 8U;
            const uint16_t shift = number % 8U;
            const uint8_t mask = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)1U << shift);

            touched[byte] |= mask;
        }
    }
}

static bool x430_is_touched(const uint8_t* touched, uint16_t index)
{
    const uint16_t byte = index / 8U;
    const uint16_t shift = index % 8U;
    const uint8_t mask = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)1U << shift);

    return (touched[byte] & mask) != 0U;
}

static void x430_store_raw_bytes(struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t address, uint16_t length,
                                 const uint8_t* data)
{
    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
    {
        const uint16_t target = x430_resolve(m, (uint16_t)((uint32_t)address + index));
        struct x430_reg reg;

        if ((x430_reg_find(target, &reg) == X430_REGISTER_COUNT) &&
            x430_touches_indirect(target, 1U))
        {
            m->table[x430_slot(target)] = data[index];
        }
    }
}

static void x430_sync_goal(struct x430_device* device)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;

    if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->read != NULL))
    {
        hooks->read(device, X430_ADDR_PRESENT_POSITION, 4U, m->config.user_data);
    }
    x430_copy(&m->table[X430_ADDR_GOAL_POSITION], &m->table[X430_ADDR_PRESENT_POSITION], 4U);
}

static uint8_t x430_enable_torque(struct x430_device* device, bool sync_goal)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;
    uint8_t result = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

    if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->write != NULL))
    {
        result = hooks->write(device, X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE, 1U, 1, m->config.user_data);
    }
    if (result == DXL2_ERR_NONE)
    {
        m->table[X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE] = 1U;
        if (sync_goal)
        {
            x430_sync_goal(device);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: STARTUP
 * =============================================================================*/

static void x430_load_factory(struct x430_device_ctx* m, uint16_t first, uint16_t last)
{
    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < X430_REGISTER_COUNT; index++)
    {
        const struct x430_reg reg = x430_reg_by_index(index);

        if ((reg.address >= first) && (reg.address <= last))
        {
            x430_raw_put(m->table, x430_slot(reg.address), reg.size, (uint32_t)reg.initial);
        }
    }
}

static void x430_load_identity(struct x430_device_ctx* m)
{
    uint8_t firmware = (uint8_t)X430_FIRMWARE_VERSION;

    if (m->config.firmware_version != 0U)
    {
        firmware = m->config.firmware_version;
    }
    x430_put(m, X430_ADDR_MODEL_NUMBER, (int32_t)X430_MODEL_NUMBER);
    m->table[X430_ADDR_FIRMWARE_VERSION] = firmware;
    x430_raw_put(m->table, X430_ADDR_MODEL_INFORMATION, 4U, m->config.model_information);
}

static void x430_startup(struct x430_device* device)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    const uint8_t startup = m->table[X430_ADDR_STARTUP_CONFIGURATION];
    const uint16_t last = (uint16_t)(X430_TABLE_SIZE - 1U);

    x430_fill(&m->table[X430_RAM_START], 0U, X430_IMAGE_SIZE - X430_RAM_START);
    x430_load_factory(m, X430_RAM_START, last);
    m->reg_length = 0U;
    m->baud_changed = false;

#if X430_FEATURE_BACKUP
    if (x430_nvm_valid(device, X430_NVM_BACKUP, X430_IMAGE_SIZE))
    {
        m->table[X430_ADDR_BACKUP_READY] = 1U;
        if ((startup & X430_STARTUP_RAM_RESTORE) != 0U)
        {
            x430_apply_backup(device, true);
        }
    }
#endif

    if ((startup & X430_STARTUP_TORQUE_ON) != 0U)
    {
        (void)x430_enable_torque(device, true);
    }
}

static int x430_check(const struct x430_device* device)
{
    const struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of_const(device);
    int result = X430_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != X430_READY)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        /* Ready. */
    }
    return result;
}

static int x430_check2(const struct x430_device* device, const void* a, const void* b)
{
    int result = X430_ERR_PARAM;

    if ((a != NULL) && (b != NULL))
    {
        result = x430_check(device);
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * INTERNAL FUNCTIONS (x430_internal.h)
 * =============================================================================*/

void x430_copy(uint8_t* destination, const uint8_t* source, uint16_t length)
{
    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
    {
        destination[index] = source[index];
    }
}

void x430_fill(uint8_t* destination, uint8_t value, uint16_t length)
{
    for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
    {
        destination[index] = value;
    }
}

int32_t x430_device_value(const struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address)
{
    return x430_get(x430_device_ctx_of_const(device), address);
}

void x430_device_store(struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, int32_t value)
{
    x430_put(x430_device_ctx_of(device), address, value);
}

uint8_t x430_device_byte(const struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address)
{
    return x430_device_ctx_of_const(device)->table[address];
}

uint8_t x430_device_alert(const struct x430_device* device)
{
    uint8_t alert = DXL2_ERR_NONE;

    if (x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_HARDWARE_ERROR_STATUS) != 0U)
    {
        alert = DXL2_ERR_ALERT_BIT;
    }
    return alert;
}

void x430_device_watchdog(struct x430_device* device, uint32_t idle_ms)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    const uint8_t timeout = m->table[X430_ADDR_BUS_WATCHDOG];

    if ((timeout != 0U) && (timeout != X430_BUS_WATCHDOG_ERROR) && x430_torque_on(m) &&
        (idle_ms > ((uint32_t)timeout * X430_BUS_WATCHDOG_UNIT_MS)))
    {
        m->table[X430_ADDR_BUS_WATCHDOG] = X430_BUS_WATCHDOG_ERROR;
        (void)x430_event(device, X430_EVENT_BUS_WATCHDOG);
    }
}

struct x430_bus* x430_device_bus(const struct x430_device* device)
{
    return x430_device_ctx_of_const(device)->bus;
}

void x430_device_attach(struct x430_device* device, struct x430_bus* bus)
{
    x430_device_ctx_of(device)->bus = bus;
}

bool x430_device_ready(const struct x430_device* device)
{
    return x430_check(device) == X430_OK;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: LIFECYCLE AND LOCK-FREE ACCESS
 * =============================================================================*/

int x430_device_init(struct x430_device* device, const struct x430_device_config* config)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    int result = X430_OK;

    if ((m == NULL) || (config == NULL) || (config->id > X430_ID_MAX))
    {
        result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        /* Field by field (no temporary copy of the context, no memset() of the C library);
           reg_data is written before it is read. */
        m->config = *config;
        m->bus = NULL;
        m->reg_address = 0U;
        m->reg_length = 0U;
        m->baud_changed = false;
        x430_fill(m->table, 0U, X430_IMAGE_SIZE);
        /* Nothing below can fail; hooks called from here may use the device. */
        m->ready = X430_READY;

        x430_load_factory(m, 0U, X430_RAM_START - 1U);
        x430_load_identity(m);
        if (config->id != 0U)
        {
            m->table[X430_ADDR_ID] = config->id;
        }
        if (x430_nvm_valid(device, X430_NVM_EEPROM, X430_RAM_START))
        {
            x430_apply_eeprom(device);
        }
        x430_startup(device);
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_get(const struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, int32_t* value)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, value, value);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_reg reg;

        if (!x430_reg_start(address, &reg))
        {
            result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
        }
        else
        {
            *value = x430_reg_value(x430_device_ctx_of_const(device), &reg);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_set(struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, int32_t value)
{
    int result = x430_check(device);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_reg reg;

        if (!x430_reg_start(address, &reg))
        {
            result = X430_ERR_PARAM;
        }
        else
        {
            x430_reg_store(x430_device_ctx_of(device), &reg, value);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_id(const struct x430_device* device, uint8_t* id)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, id, id);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        *id = x430_device_byte(device, X430_ADDR_ID);
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_raise_hardware_error(struct x430_device* device, uint8_t bits)
{
    int result = x430_check(device);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);

        m->table[X430_ADDR_HARDWARE_ERROR_STATUS] |= bits;
        if (((bits & m->table[X430_ADDR_SHUTDOWN]) != 0U) && x430_torque_on(m))
        {
            m->table[X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE] = 0U;
            (void)x430_event(device, X430_EVENT_TORQUE_SHUTDOWN);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_flush_events(struct x430_device* device)
{
    int result = x430_check(device);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);

        if (m->baud_changed)
        {
            m->baud_changed = false;
            (void)x430_event(device, X430_EVENT_BAUD_RATE);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS: INSTRUCTION SEMANTICS
 * =============================================================================*/

int x430_device_read(struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, uint16_t length, uint8_t* data,
                     uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, data, error);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
        const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;

        *error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;
        if (length == 0U)
        {
            *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
        }
        else if (((uint32_t)address + length) > X430_TABLE_SIZE)
        {
            *error = DXL2_ERR_ACCESS;
        }
        else
        {
            const uint32_t tick = x430_bus_millis(m->bus) % X430_REALTIME_TICK_PERIOD;

            x430_raw_put(m->table, X430_ADDR_REALTIME_TICK, 2U, tick);

            if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->read != NULL))
            {
                uint16_t run_start = x430_resolve(m, address);
                uint16_t run_length = 1U;

                for (uint16_t index = 1U; index < length; index++)
                {
                    const uint16_t target = x430_resolve(m, (uint16_t)((uint32_t)address + index));

                    if ((uint32_t)target == ((uint32_t)run_start + run_length))
                    {
                        run_length++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        hooks->read(device, run_start, run_length, m->config.user_data);
                        run_start = target;
                        run_length = 1U;
                    }
                }
                hooks->read(device, run_start, run_length, m->config.user_data);
            }

            for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < length; index++)
            {
                data[index] = x430_peek(m, x430_resolve(m, (uint16_t)((uint32_t)address + index)));
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

static uint8_t x430_write(struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, uint16_t length,
                          const uint8_t* data, uint8_t options)
{
    struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
    const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;
    uint8_t touched[X430_TOUCHED_BYTES];
    uint8_t result = DXL2_ERR_NONE;
    bool indirect = false;
    bool goal_written = false;
    bool eeprom_written = false;

    x430_fill(touched, 0U, X430_TOUCHED_BYTES);

    if (length == 0U)
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
    }
    else if (((uint32_t)address + length) > X430_TABLE_SIZE)
    {
        result = DXL2_ERR_ACCESS;
    }
    else
    {
        indirect = x430_touches_indirect(address, length);
        x430_mark_touched(m, address, length, touched, indirect);

        /* Pass 1: every touched register must accept its new value. */
        for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < X430_REGISTER_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if ((result == DXL2_ERR_NONE) && x430_is_touched(touched, index))
            {
                const struct x430_reg reg = x430_reg_by_index(index);
                const int32_t value =
                    x430_to_value(&reg, x430_merge(m, &reg, address, length, data, indirect));

                result = x430_check_write(device, &reg, value, options);
            }
        }
    }

    if ((result == DXL2_ERR_NONE) && ((options & X430_WRITE_VALIDATE_ONLY) == 0U))
    {
        /* Pass 2: hooks and storage, in address order. */
        for (uint16_t index = 0U; index < X430_REGISTER_COUNT; index++)
        {
            if ((result == DXL2_ERR_NONE) && x430_is_touched(touched, index))
            {
                const struct x430_reg storage = x430_reg_by_index(index);
                const struct x430_reg* reg = &storage;
                const uint32_t raw = x430_merge(m, reg, address, length, data, indirect);
                const uint16_t slot = x430_slot(reg->address);
                const uint32_t previous = x430_raw_get(m->table, slot, reg->size);

                if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->write != NULL))
                {
                    result = hooks->write(device, reg->address, reg->size, x430_to_value(reg, raw),
                                          m->config.user_data);
                }
                if (result == DXL2_ERR_NONE)
                {
                    x430_raw_put(m->table, slot, reg->size, raw);
                    if ((reg->flags & X430_REG_EEPROM) != 0U)
                    {
                        eeprom_written = true;
                    }
                    if ((reg->flags & X430_REG_GOAL) != 0U)
                    {
                        goal_written = true;
                    }
                    if ((reg->address == X430_ADDR_BAUD_RATE) && (raw != previous))
                    {
                        m->baud_changed = true;
                    }
                    if ((reg->address == X430_ADDR_TORQUE_ENABLE) && (raw != 0U) &&
                        (previous == 0U))
                    {
                        x430_sync_goal(device);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (indirect)
        {
            x430_store_raw_bytes(m, address, length, data);
        }

        if (eeprom_written)
        {
            const uint8_t stored = x430_nvm_store(device, X430_NVM_EEPROM, X430_RAM_START);

            if (result == DXL2_ERR_NONE)
            {
                result = stored;
            }
        }

        /* Drive Mode bit 3: a goal value written with torque off enables the torque. */
        if (goal_written && (result == DXL2_ERR_NONE) && !x430_torque_on(m) &&
            ((m->table[X430_ADDR_DRIVE_MODE] & X430_DRIVE_MODE_TORQUE_ON_BY_GOAL) != 0U))
        {
            result = x430_enable_torque(device, false);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_write(struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, uint16_t length,
                      const uint8_t* data, uint8_t options, uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, data, error);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        *error = x430_write(device, address, length, data, options);
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_reg_write(struct x430_device* device, uint16_t address, uint16_t length,
                          const uint8_t* data, uint8_t options, uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, data, error);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);

        if (length > X430_REG_WRITE_SIZE_U)
        {
            *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_LENGTH;
        }
        else
        {
            *error = x430_write(device, address, length, data,
                                (uint8_t)(options | X430_WRITE_VALIDATE_ONLY));
        }
        if (*error == DXL2_ERR_NONE)
        {
            x430_copy(m->reg_data, data, length);
            m->reg_address = address;
            m->reg_length = length;
            m->table[X430_ADDR_REGISTERED_INSTRUCTION] = 1U;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_action(struct x430_device* device, uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, error, error);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);

        *error = DXL2_ERR_INSTRUCTION;
        if (m->reg_length != 0U)
        {
            const uint16_t length = m->reg_length;

            m->reg_length = 0U;
            m->table[X430_ADDR_REGISTERED_INSTRUCTION] = 0U;
            *error = x430_write(device, m->reg_address, length, m->reg_data, 0U);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_reboot(struct x430_device* device)
{
    int result = x430_check(device);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        x430_startup(device);
        (void)x430_event(device, X430_EVENT_REBOOT);
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_factory_reset(struct x430_device* device, uint8_t option, uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, error, error);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);

        *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
        if ((option == X430_FACTORY_RESET_ALL) || (option == X430_FACTORY_RESET_EXCEPT_ID) ||
            (option == X430_FACTORY_RESET_EXCEPT_ID_BAUD))
        {
            const uint8_t id = m->table[X430_ADDR_ID];
            const uint8_t baud = m->table[X430_ADDR_BAUD_RATE];

            x430_load_factory(m, 0U, X430_RAM_START - 1U);
            x430_load_identity(m);
            if (option != X430_FACTORY_RESET_ALL)
            {
                m->table[X430_ADDR_ID] = id;
            }
            else if ((m->config.id != 0U) && !x430_bus_id_taken(m->bus, device, m->config.id))
            {
                m->table[X430_ADDR_ID] = m->config.id;
            }
            else
            {
                /* Factory ID from the model table (1). */
            }
            if (option == X430_FACTORY_RESET_EXCEPT_ID_BAUD)
            {
                m->table[X430_ADDR_BAUD_RATE] = baud;
            }
            *error = x430_nvm_store(device, X430_NVM_EEPROM, X430_RAM_START);
            x430_startup(device);
            m->baud_changed = m->table[X430_ADDR_BAUD_RATE] != baud;
            (void)x430_event(device, X430_EVENT_FACTORY_RESET);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_clear(struct x430_device* device, uint8_t option, uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, error, error);

    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
        const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;

        if (option != X430_CLEAR_MULTI_TURN)
        {
            *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
        }
        else if (m->table[X430_ADDR_MOVING] != 0U)
        {
            *error = DXL2_ERR_RESULT_FAIL;
        }
        else if ((hooks != NULL) && (hooks->event != NULL))
        {
            *error = hooks->event(device, X430_EVENT_CLEAR_MULTI_TURN, m->config.user_data);
        }
        else
        {
            int32_t position = x430_get(m, X430_ADDR_PRESENT_POSITION) % X430_PULSES_PER_TURN;

            if (position < 0)
            {
                position += X430_PULSES_PER_TURN;
            }
            x430_put(m, X430_ADDR_PRESENT_POSITION, position);
            *error = DXL2_ERR_NONE;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int x430_device_backup(struct x430_device* device, uint8_t option, uint8_t* error)
{
    int result = x430_check2(device, error, error);

#if X430_FEATURE_BACKUP
    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        struct x430_device_ctx* m = x430_device_ctx_of(device);
        const struct x430_hooks* hooks = m->config.hooks;

        *error = DXL2_ERR_DATA_RANGE;
        if (option == X430_BACKUP_STORE)
        {
            *error = x430_nvm_store(device, X430_NVM_BACKUP, X430_IMAGE_SIZE);
            if ((*error == DXL2_ERR_NONE) && (hooks != NULL) && (hooks->nvm_write != NULL))
            {
                m->table[X430_ADDR_BACKUP_READY] = 1U;
            }
        }
        else if (option == X430_BACKUP_RESTORE)
        {
            if (x430_torque_on(m))
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_ACCESS;
            }
            else if (!x430_nvm_valid(device, X430_NVM_BACKUP, X430_IMAGE_SIZE))
            {
                *error = DXL2_ERR_RESULT_FAIL;
            }
            else
            {
                x430_apply_backup(device, false);
                *error = x430_nvm_store(device, X430_NVM_EEPROM, X430_RAM_START);
                (void)x430_event(device, X430_EVENT_BACKUP_RESTORED);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* Unknown option: Data Range Error. */
        }
    }
#else
    (void)option;
    if (result == X430_OK)
    {
        result = X430_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
    }
#endif
    return result;
}

Completes a status packet in place (no second buffer): header, id , the byte stuffing of instruction, error and data, the length field and the CRC. 

size_t x430_frame_status (
    uint8_t * tx,
    size_t capacity,
    uint8_t id,
    uint16_t count
)

The result is byte for byte the packet of dxl2_encode(). A status whose stuffed form does not fit capacity becomes a Data Length Error without data (the alert bit is kept).

Parameters:

  • tx Packet buffer: error byte at offset 8, count data bytes from 9.
  • capacity Size of tx, at least 9 + count and at least 11 bytes.
  • id ID of the answering device.
  • count Status data bytes.

Returns:

Packet length (at least 11).

/* ==============================================================================

#include "x430.h"
